== Printed text and separate Supplement ruling ==
The existing [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], p. 3, prints the three Evader modes in italics, then separately explains the Death Star Assault Squadron interaction. The article now keeps that explanation under rulings instead of appending it to printed game text. The physical Decipher and both PC face lores say “sent”, correcting imported “send” metadata. == Documentary source illustration ==
The primary illustration now uses the actual 2002 Glossary Supplement entry, PDF page 3, rather than the later full PC image. The existing <code>2_131</code> binding and documentary game text remain unchanged. Actual physical original: [[:File:ANH-D-evader-hires.webp]]. Actual 1998 source: [[:File:ANH-D-Evader-Decipher-Glossary-1998-p57-entry.png]]. The actual 2002 source [[:File:ANH-D-Evader-Decipher-Supplement-2002-p3-entry.png]] retains the same game words but explains Death Star Assault Squadron through Vader’s persona; the 1998 entry explains it as retrieval of one card. These explanations remain labelled by source edition. The credited [[:File:ANH-D-evader-errata-hires.webp|strangewayes fan rendition]] remains an explicit comparison; it is not a scan of either PDF.
